messages.author: ac2d2e4dc0e3cb16
messages.subject: download pdf
parts:
1: (slightly out of topic): I am very enthousiastic about rApache. It works like a dream. I will never use php anymore. Thank you!
2. I want to send a pdf file to the user. In the documentation is written that a png file is generated als follows:

setContentType("image/png")
t <- tempfile()
png(t,type="cairo")
plot(rnorm(10))
dev.off()
sendBin(readBin(t,'raw',n=file.info(t)$size))
unlink(t)

Now I want to do the same with a (existing) pdf file. So I tried:
setContentType ("application/pdf")
temp <- "/var/www/limesurvey/tmp/o.pdf"
sendBin (readBin (temp, 'raw', n=file.info(temp)$size))

But this does not work. Probably the headers are incorrect.
Does anyone know how this can be done?
Thanks
Frans Marcelissen
(fransiepan...@gmail.com)

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: download pdf
parts:
You've got the right idea, and I'm unsure why it's not working. I've got a project that uses almost that exact pattern:

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/REDCapCustomReports/blob/master/rapache/report-generator.R#L282

Now, to be fair, the pdf output of the above handler actually gets consumed by a PHP script:

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/REDCapCustomReports/blob/master/REDCap/ProjectReports/live_report.php#L55

Note that the PHP is printing out an additional header:

if ($html['content_type'] == 'application/pdf'){
header("Content-disposition: inline; filename=\"$project_name.pdf\"");
}

messages.author: ac2d2e4dc0e3cb16
messages.subject: Re: download pdf
parts:
Thank  you for the answer. I still do'nt understand what to do.
I want that the user is asked where he should load the file.
Under php this can be done as follows:

header("Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=" . urlencode($file));  
header("Content-Type: application/octet-stream");
header("Content-Type: application/download");
header("Content-Description: File Transfer");           
header("Content-Length: " . filesize($file));



Under r the (full) file is as follows:

setContentType ("application/pdf")
temp <- "/tmp/o.pdf"

You can see the result at http://www.dpvragenlijst.nl/loadpdf.r

The result is that (under firefox) the file is downloaded as "loadpdf.r". Under internet exporer the content is displayed in the browser. Both is not what I want.
I suppose, in order to do the same as under php the other header lines should be specified as well. My question is: how can I do that under r/rapache?
Thanks
--------------------------------------------------------------------

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: download pdf
parts:
Use the rApache function setHeader to replicate those headers:

setHeader("Content-Disposition", paste('attachment; filename="', yourFileName))
setHeader("Content-Description", "File Transfer")

You get the idea. Looks like you set the Content-Type header twice? Why?
